text:
"""P02: round-1 sheets that the C model (fitted to the arena's relationship charge) scores far higher than the
358.20/45 d/index sheet Nordmark always agrees to: no index at 363.5/60 d and 365.5/90 d, index at 361.5/90 d."""
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from plib import msg, their_sheet, their_price, our_last_price

CASE = "case:P02"
IDX = {"series": "CU-NOTATION", "material_share": 0.2, "deadband_pct": 5, "base_month": "2026-08"}


def move(st):
    r = st["round"]
    last = st["last"]
    if r > 1 and last.get("status") in ("agreed", "final_offer"):
        return {"accept": their_sheet(st)[0]}
    if r == 1:
        body = ("Dear Ms Lechner,\n\nthank you for your letter of 14 September. We understand the copper pressure and "
                "want a basis that is sustainable for you.\n\n"
                "Our volume forecast for part:350011 changed by +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).\n\n"
                "We can offer: A) EUR 363.50 per unit, 60 days, fixed price without a clause; B) EUR 365.50, 90 days, "
                "fixed price; C) EUR 361.50, 90 days, with your CU-NOTATION clause (20% share, 5% deadband).\n\n"
                "Kind regards\nHollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing")
        return msg("Motor IE3 7.5 kW - your letter of 14 September", body, [
            {"unit_price": 363.5, "payment_days": 60, "index_clause": None},
            {"unit_price": 365.5, "payment_days": 90, "index_clause": None},
            {"unit_price": 361.5, "payment_days": 90, "index_clause": IDX}])
    prev = our_last_price(st)
    p = round(prev + 0.3 * (their_price(st) - prev), 2)
    body = (f"Dear Ms Lechner,\n\nthank you. We can move to EUR {p:.2f}, 60 days, fixed price; or keep EUR 361.50, "
            "90 days with your clause.\n\nKind regards\nHollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing")
    return msg("Re: Motor IE3 7.5 kW", body, [{"unit_price": p, "payment_days": 60, "index_clause": None},
                                             {"unit_price": 361.5, "payment_days": 90, "index_clause": IDX}])

case.title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG. Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor. Need: 6110 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 36 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200002. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Ms Lechner,

thank you for your letter of 14 September. We understand the copper pressure and want a basis that is sustainable for you.

Our volume forecast for part:350011 changed by +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).

We can offer: A) EUR 363.50 per unit, 60 days, fixed price without a clause; B) EUR 365.50, 90 days, fixed price; C) EUR 361.50, 90 days, with your CU-NOTATION clause (20% share, 5% deadband).

response.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
response.subject: Re: Motor IE3 7.5 kW - your letter of 14 September
response.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge the updated volume forecast and have incorporated this positive development into our calculation. We can accept your terms and await your order. 

Our Angebot is valid for 30 days and comprises a price of €361.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. 

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Credit Control: We refer to our standard Zahlungsziel, which is 30 days net.
